entries.owner: Repository maintainer (implementation); product/repository owner for release acceptance in M11.7
entries.applicability: Retained Metro0.83.3 build-time image parsing through React Native0.81.5 and @react-native/metro-config0.81.5. Metro Assets.js passes asset bytes to image-size1.2.1. No authored upload feature; malicious repository/dependency asset bytes can still reach parser. Run04 native builds passed; build success and Run05 font assets do not fix the advisory.
